author: StephenM
text:
NEW: ICE has arrested three Guatemalan illegal aliens with final deportation orders in Knoxville, TN as part of an investigation into fraudulent use of stolen identities and social security numbers. Feds say one victim, a New York woman, repeatedly had wages falsely attributed to her SSN which required to her to contact officials over and over to get the wages removed from her record. 

ICE statement:

“These crimes have real victims,” said ICE New Orleans acting Field Office Director Scott Ladwig. “Fraudulent documents and stolen identities can cause lasting harm to victims, workers and businesses. I commend our officers and partners for their work to hold offenders accountable and protect our communities.”
